propositions: Without declared file_impact, currency over-triggers re-review on any code-SHA change, affecting 21% of full re-reviews on byte-identical material; the fail-safe must be scoped to the signed read-set and cited paths instead of invalidating on arbitrary code drift.

The read-set (normalized from distinct_fetches) must be recorded in the signed manifest by filtering to read_file tool, resolving paths against hash root, dropping outside-repo and nonexistent entries, deduping, and recording only when fetches are observed.

When the pre-existing dependency set is empty, container poison is not in effect, scope is undeclared, and a read-set is recorded, the ADR-0002 dependency check must compose read-set with blast-radius entries (criteria config, rebar.toml, rubric files, workflow gates) to detect content drift.

Glob patterns in the blast radius must be expanded at attestation time with membership digests recording the sorted match list, so file additions/deletions under a glob pattern invalidate currency without baking per-file hashes.

The signed manifest must record a currency-basis field (file_impact | read-set | fail-safe) indicating which mechanism triggered the check; pre-change and failed-expansion cases must fall back to whole-HEAD invalidation.
Already-scoped sets, poisoned containers, and declared-none tickets must remain exempt from the read-set scoping to preserve existing invalidation semantics and fail-closed behavior.
